name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 20 - Am 73
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 20d. Calls for measures supporting housing cost neutrality as a principle determining that the overall cost for tenants stays the same, including after renovations, especially if those renovations are carried out using public funds, and also to improve tenants’ protection from ‘renovictions’, which can occur when a property owner sends an eviction notice, citing the need for major renovations;
